_comment: Items whose examine is worth asking even though it trips Guess the Examine's name
check (server/scripts/gen_examine_questions.py): the examine contains the item's name,
or a word of it longer than three characters. Usually that is the answer written on
the card and the item is rightly left out. Sometimes the word is only what kind of
thing it is ('A very powerful onyx amulet.'), or the line is too good to lose
('Yuck I don't like cabbage.'). Those go here.
names  item names exactly as data/popular-items.json writes them. A name that is
not on the roster fails the generator rather than doing nothing.
This cannot let through an examine two roster items share: that is two right
answers in one list, not a matter of taste. Run `make gen-examine-questions` after
editing, and keep the list sorted.
